TJK.IsFσ.statement: def IsFσ (s : Set X) : Prop := ∃ F : ℕ → Set X, (∀ n, IsClosed (F n)) ∧ s = ⋃ n, F n

TJK.IsFσδ.statement: def IsFσδ (s : Set X) : Prop := ∃ A : ℕ → Set X, (∀ n, IsFσ (A n)) ∧ s = ⋂ n, A n

TJK.IsAmbiguous.statement: def IsAmbiguous (s : Set X) : Prop := IsFσ s ∧ IsGδ s end Sets section Functions variable {X : Type u} {Y : Type v} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y]

TJK.IsFσMeasurable.statement: def IsFσMeasurable (f : X → Y) : Prop := ∀ U : Set Y, IsOpen U → IsFσ (f ⁻¹' U)

TJK.IsBaireOne.statement: def IsBaireOne (f : X → Y) : Prop := ∃ F : ℕ → X → Y, (∀ n, Continuous (F n)) ∧ ∀ x, Tendsto (fun n => F n x) atTop (𝓝 (f x))

TJK.IsHonoraryBaireTwo.statement: def IsHonoraryBaireTwo (f : X → Y) : Prop := ∃ N : Set X, N.Countable ∧ ∃ g : X → Y, IsBaireOne g ∧ ∀ x ∉ N, f x = g x

TJK.BaireClass.statement: inductive BaireClass : Ordinal.{0} → (X → Y) → Prop | zero {f : X → Y} : Continuous f → BaireClass 0 f | lim {ξ : Ordinal.{0}} {f : X → Y} (η : ℕ → Ordinal.{0}) (F : ℕ → X → Y) : 0 < ξ → (∀ n, η n < ξ) → (∀ n, BaireClass (η n) (F n)) → (∀ x, Tendsto (fun n => F n x) atTop (𝓝 (f x))) → BaireClass ξ f end Functions section Arcs variable {E : Type u} [TopologicalSpace E] {Y : Type v} [TopologicalSpace Y]

TJK.IsArc.statement: def IsArc (γ : Set E) (a b : E) : Prop := ∃ p : Path a b, Function.Injective p ∧ range p = γ

TJK.IsArcAt.statement: def IsArcAt (Ω : Set E) (x : E) (γ : Set E) : Prop := ∃ b, IsArc γ x b ∧ γ \ {x} ⊆ Ω

TJK.IsCrosscut.statement: def IsCrosscut (Ω B : Set E) (γ : Set E) : Prop := ∃ a b, a ≠ b ∧ a ∈ B ∧ b ∈ B ∧ IsArc γ a b ∧ γ \ {a, b} ⊆ Ω

TJK.curvConvSet.statement: def curvConvSet (Ω B : Set E) (f : E → Y) : Set E := {x | x ∈ B ∧ ∃ γ, IsArcAt Ω x γ ∧ ∃ q, Tendsto f (𝓝[γ \ {x}] x) (𝓝 q)}

TJK.IsBoundaryFunction.statement: def IsBoundaryFunction (Ω : Set E) (f : E → Y) (S : Set E) (φ : E → Y) : Prop := ∀ x ∈ S, ∃ γ, IsArcAt Ω x γ ∧ Tendsto f (𝓝[γ \ {x}] x) (𝓝 (φ x))

TJK.clusterSet.statement: def clusterSet (f : E → Y) (γ : Set E) (x : E) : Set Y := {q | MapClusterPt q (𝓝[γ \ {x}] x) f} end Arcs

TJK.Sphere2.statement: abbrev Sphere2 : Type := Metric.sphere (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) 1 end TJK

TJK.McMillan.isFσδ_curvConvSet.statement: theorem McMillan.isFσδ_curvConvSet {K : Type*} [MetricSpace K] [CompleteSpace K] [TopologicalSpace.SeparableSpace K] (f : ℂ → K) (hf : ContinuousOn f disc) : IsFσδ (curvConvSet disc circle f)

TJK.McMillan.isFσδ_clusterSet_subset.statement: theorem McMillan.isFσδ_clusterSet_subset {K : Type*} [MetricSpace K] [CompactSpace K] (ℰ : Set (TopologicalSpace.NonemptyCompacts K)) (hℰ : IsClosed ℰ) (f : ℂ → K) (hf : ContinuousOn f disc) : IsFσδ {x | x ∈ circle ∧ ∃ γ, IsArcAt disc x γ ∧ ∃ E ∈ ℰ, clusterSet f γ x ⊆ (E : Set K)}

TJK.BoundaryFn.exists_countable_isFσMeas.statement: theorem BoundaryFn.exists_countable_isFσMeasurable {Y : Type*} [MetricSpace Y] [TopologicalSpace.SeparableSpace Y] (f : ℂ → Y) (hf : ContinuousOn f upper) (E : Set ℂ) (hE : E ⊆ realAxis) (φ : ℂ → Y) (hφ : IsBoundaryFunction upper f E φ) : ∃ M ⊆ E, M.Countable ∧ IsFσMeasurable ((E \ M).restrict φ)

TJK.BoundaryFn.isHonoraryBaireTwo_disc_r.statement: theorem BoundaryFn.isHonoraryBaireTwo_disc_real (f : ℂ → ℝ) (hf : ContinuousOn f disc) (E : Set ℂ) (hE : E ⊆ circle) (φ : ℂ → ℝ) (hφ : IsBoundaryFunction disc f E φ) : IsHonoraryBaireTwo (E.restrict φ)

TJK.BoundaryFn.isHonoraryBaireTwo_disc_s.statement: theorem BoundaryFn.isHonoraryBaireTwo_disc_sphere (f : ℂ → Sphere2) (hf : ContinuousOn f disc) (E : Set ℂ) (hE : E ⊆ circle) (φ : ℂ → Sphere2) (hφ : IsBoundaryFunction disc f E φ) : IsHonoraryBaireTwo (E.restrict φ)

TJK.Homeo.exists_countable_continuousOn.statement: theorem Homeo.exists_countable_continuousOn (e : disc ≃ₜ disc) (f : ℂ → ℂ) (hfe : ∀ z : disc, f z = e z) (E : Set ℂ) (hE : E ⊆ circle) (φ : ℂ → ℂ) (hφ : IsBoundaryFunction disc f E φ) : ∃ N ⊆ E, N.Countable ∧ ContinuousOn φ (E \ N)

TJK.Construct.exists_curvConvSet_eq_uppe.statement: theorem Construct.exists_curvConvSet_eq_upperHalfPlane (A : Set ℝ) (hA : IsFσδ A) : ∃ f : ℂ → ℂ, ContinuousOn f upper ∧ Bornology.IsBounded (f '' upper) ∧ curvConvSet upper realAxis f = ((↑) : ℝ → ℂ) '' A

TJK.Construct.exists_f_sphere.statement: theorem Construct.exists_f_sphere (A : Set ℂ) (hA : A ⊆ circle) (hAF : IsFσδ A) (φ : ℂ → Sphere2) (hφ : IsHonoraryBaireTwo (A.restrict φ)) : ∃ f : ℂ → Sphere2, ContinuousOn f disc ∧ curvConvSet disc circle f = A ∧ IsBoundaryFunction disc f A φ

TJK.Construct.exists_boundaryFn_euclidea.statement: theorem Construct.exists_boundaryFn_euclidean {m : ℕ} (E : Set ℝ) (φ : ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)) (hφ : IsHonoraryBaireTwo (E.restrict φ)) : ∃ f : ℂ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m), ContinuousOn f upper ∧ IsBoundaryFunction upper f (((↑) : ℝ → ℂ) '' E) (fun z => φ z.re)

TJK.Discont.baireClass_succ_of_boundaryF.statement: theorem Discont.baireClass_succ_of_boundaryFn {Y : Type} [MetricSpace Y] [TopologicalSpace.SeparableSpace Y] [PathConnectedSpace Y] (ξ : Ordinal.{0}) (hξ : 1 ≤ ξ) (f : ℂ → Y) (hf : BaireClass ξ (upper.restrict f)) (E : Set ℂ) (hE : E ⊆ realAxis) (φ : ℂ → Y) (hφ : IsBoundaryFunction upper f E φ) : BaireClass (ξ + 1) (E.restrict φ)

TJK.Discont.exists_disjoint_null_arcs.statement: theorem Discont.exists_disjoint_null_arcs : ∃ γ : ℝ → Set ℂ, (∀ x : ℝ, IsArcAt upper (x : ℂ) (γ x)) ∧ Pairwise (fun x y => Disjoint (γ x) (γ y)) ∧ volume (⋃ x, γ x) = 0

TJK.Discont.exists_ae_zero_boundaryFn.statement: theorem Discont.exists_ae_zero_boundaryFn {Y : Type*} [MetricSpace Y] (y₀ : Y) (φ : ℝ → Y) : ∃ f : ℂ → Y, (∀ᵐ z ∂volume, f z = y₀) ∧ IsBoundaryFunction upper f realAxis (fun z => φ z.re)

TJK.Discont.exists_measurable_nonmeasura.statement: theorem Discont.exists_measurable_nonmeasurable_boundaryFn : ∃ f : ℂ → ℝ, NullMeasurable f volume ∧ ∃ φ : ℂ → ℝ, IsBoundaryFunction upper f realAxis φ ∧ ¬ NullMeasurable (fun x : ℝ => φ x) volume

TJK.Harmonic.exists_bounded_harmonic_bou.statement: theorem Harmonic.exists_bounded_harmonic_boundaryFn_not_baireOne : ∃ f : ℂ → ℝ, InnerProductSpace.HarmonicOnNhd f disc ∧ Bornology.IsBounded (f '' disc) ∧ ∃ φ : ℂ → ℝ, IsBoundaryFunction disc f circle φ ∧ ¬ IsBaireOne (circle.restrict φ)

TJK.Harmonic.isMeagre_asymptotic_diff_ge.statement: theorem Harmonic.isMeagre_asymptotic_diff_generalLimit (u : ℂ → ℝ) (hu : InnerProductSpace.HarmonicOnNhd u disc) (p : ℝ) (hp : 1 < p) (hmean : ∃ B : ℝ, ∀ r ∈ Ico (0 : ℝ) 1, ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), |u (r * Complex.exp (θ * Complex.I))| ^ p ≤ B) : IsMeagre ((Subtype.val : circle → ℂ) ⁻¹' (curvConvSet disc circle u \ {ζ | ∃ L, Tendsto u (𝓝[disc] ζ) (𝓝 L)}))

TJK.Cube.openCube.statement: def Cube.openCube : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) := {v | v 0 ∈ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1 ∧ v 1 ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧ v 2 ∈ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1}

TJK.Cube.exists_not_measurableSet_curvCo.statement: theorem Cube.exists_not_measurableSet_curvConvSet : ∃ f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) → ℂ, ContinuousOn f Cube.openCube ∧ Bornology.IsBounded (f '' Cube.openCube) ∧ ¬ MeasurableSet (curvConvSet Cube.openCube (frontier Cube.openCube) f)

TJK.Sutcliffe.IsSolution.statement: def IsSolution (n k : ℕ) (L : List ℕ) : Prop := 2 ≤ n ∧ 1 < k ∧ L ≠ [] ∧ 0 < L.headI ∧ 0 < L.getLastI ∧ (∀ a ∈ L, a ≤ n - 1) ∧ k * Nat.ofDigits n L = Nat.ofDigits n L.reverse

TJK.Sutcliffe.HasSolution.statement: def HasSolution (n d : ℕ) : Prop := ∃ k L, L.length = d ∧ IsSolution n k L

TJK.Sutcliffe.two_digit_of_three_digit.statement: theorem two_digit_of_three_digit {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) (h : HasSolution n 3) : HasSolution n 2

TJK.Sutcliffe.three_digit_iff.statement: theorem three_digit_iff {n : ℕ} (hn : 3 < n) : HasSolution n 3 ↔ ¬ (n + 1).Prime

TJK.Sutcliffe.two_digit_iff.statement: theorem two_digit_iff {n : ℕ} (hn : 4 ≤ n) : HasSolution n 2 ↔ ¬ (n + 1).Prime

TJK.Sutcliffe.three_digit_of_two_digit.statement: theorem three_digit_of_two_digit {n : ℕ} (h : HasSolution n 2) : HasSolution n 3
